langganan.title: Monthly maintenance contracts for repeat customers
langganan.why: {count} customers have ordered more than once. They rebook by hand — a monthly contract turns that into steady revenue and locks in the schedule.

berkala.title: Follow-up service for jobs older than 30 days
berkala.why: {count} jobs finished over a month ago and those customers haven't booked again. A scheduled service is a natural reason to get in touch.

garansi.title: Extended warranty for high-value jobs
garansi.why: {count} jobs are worth more than average. At that size, customers will usually pay for peace of mind — and your claim cost is low because the work is new.

bundling.title: Add-on bundle for "{type}"
bundling.why: "{type}" is your most requested service with no add-on attached. One small add-on on every quote raises the value without adding visits.

tertahan.title: Revive stalled quotes with a small bonus
tertahan.why: {count} quotes haven't been answered for more than 3 days. A small conditional freebie often restarts a conversation that went quiet.

marginkatalog.title: Fix thin-margin VAS items
marginkatalog.why: {count} active items have a margin under 25%. Raising the price or cutting the cost of items that already sell is easier than finding new customers.

empty.title: Log a few requests and completed jobs first
empty.body: Opportunities come from the jobs you have logged. Once there is some history, this page points to the customers and services ready for an add-on.

section.title: Opportunities from your jobs
section.note: Average catalog margin {pct}% · figures refresh every time the page opens

catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search items, parent services or categories…
catalog.emptyBody: Add one item, or paste your whole price list with Bulk import.
catalog.noMatch: No matching items. Change the search or the status filter.

offer.label: Raise quote value
offer.problem: My quotes stop at the basic service. I want every quote to carry one relevant add-on without putting customers off.

contract.label: Monthly maintenance contract
contract.problem: I want to turn repeat customers into monthly maintenance contracts so revenue is more predictable.

margin.label: Fix catalog margins
margin.problem: Some of my add-ons are priced too low. I want to know which to reprice or retire.

editor.name: Item name
editor.costHint: Materials and time actually spent on this item.
editor.attachHint: The service name exactly as in requests, e.g. AC cleaning.
editor.rateHint: The share of customers who usually take this item.
editor.descPlaceholder: One or two sentences your customers can read.
editor.description: This item appears as an add-on in quotes and counts toward the catalog potential.
editor.priceRequired: Price must be more than zero.

delete.title: Delete this VAS item?
delete.description: "{name}" will be removed from the catalog. Revenue already recorded stays as it is.

bulk.label: Paste data
bulk.hint: Two formats are accepted: a JSON array, or one line per item separated by | — name | price | cost | category | service | attach rate.
bulk.placeholder:
3-month AC maintenance | 450000 | 120000 | perawatan | AC cleaning | 30
Express carpet wash | 250000 | 60000 | kecepatan | Sofa & carpet wash | 20
bulk.skip: Skip items whose name is already in the catalog
bulk.title: Bulk import VAS items
bulk.description: Paste from a spreadsheet or pick a JSON/CSV file. Any bad row rejects the whole import so the catalog is never half-done.
bulk.allDupes: Every row is already in the catalog. Nothing was imported.

parse.empty: There is no data to import.
parse.badJson: Invalid JSON. Check commas and quotes.
parse.notArray: The JSON must be a list of items.
